name: data-attr-without-testid
description: Elements that carry any custom `data-*` attribute but no `data-testid`. Useful for projects that enforce a testing-id convention; the heuristic is `if you needed any data-*, you probably want a testid too`. Allow-list deviating elements via project overlay.

filter.reason: Element has custom data-* but no data-testid — add one or surface a documented exception.
